description: Every administrative boundary containing a point, country first down to the smallest district. Use it to tag an address, a store or a delivery with its country, state, county and city in one call. Costs 1 unit. Returns ids you can pass to get_boundary. Answered from our own polygons in well under a second for any point on land or in territorial waters; postcode areas are not included in such an answer. Choose levels by kind: admin_level is OpenStreetMap's number and is null where we do not hold it. Only a point no division contains (open sea, Antarctica) is looked up in OpenStreetMap; when that is slow or down, the call answers the boundaries already cached with polygons, marked partial: true with retry_after and a hint (city, district or postcode may be missing), or 503 upstream_unavailable with retry_after when none is cached. A slow lookup keeps running, so the same call after retry_after is served complete from the cache. Needs an API key or a connected account.
name: reverse_boundaries
title: Boundaries at a point
